<p align="center"><em>Your media. Interactive subtitles. Learning tools right where you need them.</em></p>

## One app, from immersion to review

- **Watch, read, and listen.** Local videos, YouTube, manga, EPUBs, web novels, and podcasts in one app.
- **Understand in context.** Look up words with your imported dictionaries, use on-device manga OCR, and work with interactive subtitles.
- **Keep what matters.** Save sentences with audio and images where available. Review in Manatan SRS with account sync, or keep using Anki.

Desktop and Android installers are also available on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/KolbyML/Manatan/releases/latest).

## Your first lookup

1. Install and open Manatan. A dictionary is installed automatically.
2. Open a video with subtitles, a manga chapter, or an EPUB you want to understand.
3. Look up a word. Save a useful sentence to Manatan SRS or Anki, then keep going.

[Illustrated setup guide](https://manatan.com/blog/getting-started-manatan) · [AnkiConnect](https://manatan.com/blog/connect-manatan-anki-ankiconnect)

*The linked guides are currently in English.*
